name: FileDropzone
summary: Drag-and-drop file input. Large dashed-bordered tap target wrapping a hidden native <input type='file'>. Distinct rest, hover, and drag-over states; supports single and multi-file selection.

onFiles.description: Fires with the selected File[] on pick or drop.

maxSize.description: Max file size in bytes; files larger than this are rejected with an error.

hint.default: PDF, CSV, XLSX up to 25 MB

keyboard: Space / Enter — open the native file picker
Tab — focus the remove button on each picked file
rules: Whole dropzone is a <label> wrapping the input — click affordance correct AND screen readers announce 'file picker'.
accept and multiple pass through to the inner <input>.
After files are picked, a polite live region announces the count.
Drag-over events visually indicate 'you can drop here'; consumer must call e.preventDefault() on onDragOver.

do: Pass accept for known MIME types or extensions.
Pass maxSize and validate client-side; show a polite error.
Show picked files with a remove affordance.
Surface upload progress beneath each file row (consumer responsibility).
dont: Don't auto-upload silently — let the user confirm or clear before the request fires.
Don't disable the picker as the only error treatment — show a hint and let them retry.
Don't allow dropping arbitrary files when accept is set — filter on drop.

changelog.note: Initial release. Promotes the v0.6 audit-dashboard primitive in inputs.tsx to a dedicated contract. Single + multi-file modes; native <input type='file'> behind a labeled drop target with distinct rest / hover / drag-over states.
